snippet.title: Dagger Directive Leaves Early Access August 13 - Full 1.0 Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Dagger Directive leaves Early Access and launches Version 1.0 on August 13 — its biggest update yet. The Global Ops Expansion adds a brand-new campaign with five new missions, new objectives, and new enemy encounters, plus an expanded arsenal featuring the MK18, P90, M17, and M32 Grenade Launcher.

Version 1.0 also brings smarter AI, controller support, Steam Deck compatibility, Steam Workshop integration for community content, and numerous quality-of-life improvements.

Play now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2437670/Dagger_Directive/

#DaggerDirective #MicroProse #TacticalShooter
